name: Helen Killmier
title: Psychologist (Community), Founder
description: Helen works with adults and adolescents providing counselling and psychotherapy, including for trauma. Her therapeutic practice encompasses approaches including Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Parts Therapy/Internal Family Systems and Schema Therapy. Helen has very limited capacity and may not be able to accept new referrals.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, parts therapy/IFS, schema therapy, disability, neurodiversity

name: Catherine Killmier
title: Psychologist, Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: She provides support for individuals facing challenges related to trauma, disability, and social or systemic adversity, including those with dual diagnoses. With a neurodiversity-affirming perspective, Catherine works with children, adolescents and adults; modalities include trauma-informed therapy and Schema Therapy, as well as art, expressive and play therapies.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, neurodiversity-affirming, play/art therapy

name: Kate Bennett
title: Psychologist
description: Kate offers counselling and psychotherapy that is person-centred, trauma-informed, and neurodiversity-affirming, working with children, adolescents, and adults; concerns supported include trauma. She has a particular interest in working with young people and adults who are newly diagnosed or exploring their neurodivergence.

name: Tania Zapparoni
title: Counselling Psychologist & Family Therapist
description: Tania provides counselling and psychotherapy for children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families, addressing challenges including trauma. She employs a client-centred, strengths-based, and neurodiversity-affirming approach, and her evidence-based methods include EMDR. 30 years of experience; accredited Family Therapist.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, family therapy, couples, neurodiversity

name: Deborah (Deb) Gray
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Deborah provides trauma therapies: EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing) and Internal Family Systems Therapy (commonly known as "Parts Therapy"). She addresses mental health challenges in adults including PTSD, complex PTSD, somatic and dissociative symptoms, and addictions. Member of the EMDR Association of Australia (EMDRAA).
specialties: EMDR, IFS/parts therapy, PTSD, complex PTSD, dissociative symptoms, schema therapy, disability

name: Jessie Hill
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: Jessie is passionate about supporting the mental health of adolescents, young adults, and their families, using a collaborative and neurodiversity-affirming approach. Her therapeutic work incorporates approaches including Trauma-Informed Therapy and Motivational Interviewing.
specialties: trauma-informed therapy, adolescents, young adults, neurodiversity
